lessons.future_rule: Do not re-open a closed cross short in the same swing unless price resets to a fresh extreme and the original invalidation is clearly not in force. A failed floor, peer covering, or a firm commodity tape is a reason to stay flat until a new extreme exists.
lessons.text: A cross short that has already fallen through the entry extreme is a completed expression. Re-opening it just below the exit, into a failed nearby floor while commodities are bid and other shorts are covering, treats a finished trade as a new one.
